subject.title: fix: recover managed npm plugin lock metadata

question: Should the linked startup-loop issue use this state-aware full-pipeline recovery or the narrower implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107257 as its canonical fix?
rationale: Both PRs target the same release-blocking failure, but they differ in whether quarantine state survives later validation failures; selecting a permanent rollback contract requires owner judgment after real behavior proof is supplied.

options.title: Adopt this state-aware fix
options.body: After real npm repair proof, use this branch because it explicitly prevents post-quarantine failures from restoring the original poisoned snapshot.

options.title: Adopt the narrower candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107257 only after proving and covering its rollback behavior for failures occurring after the clean rebuild starts.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both PRs unmerged until a real managed-project startup repair demonstrates which recovery converges without weakening integrity verification.

recommendation.title: Adopt this state-aware fix
recommendation.body: After real npm repair proof, use this branch because it explicitly prevents post-quarantine failures from restoring the original poisoned snapshot.
